Trigger
Recipient
Sent fields and limits
Approximate area detection
Builder initialization; widget coarse-detection paths, including local/preferLocal resolution and Reset re-detection when the resolver requires it.
GeoJS https://get.geojs.io/v1/ip/geo.json, then https://ipinfo.io/json on failure.
Connection IP; neither URL has typed-query or coordinate parameters. IANA timezone detection uses local Intl. IP-derived area is approximate and is not precise permission or GPS.
Place/postcode search
Builder one-second debounce or Enter; widget Settings Enter. Trimmed queries shorter than 2 make no request.
Nominatim https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search
q contains the trimmed query; format=jsonv2, addressdetails=1, limit=5. countrycodes is the known home country only for a query containing a digit; alphabetic London has no digit-country bias.
Canadian-style prefix assist
Whitespace removed from a query with a leading letter-digit-letter pattern; in addition to Nominatim.
Zippopotam https://api.zippopotam.us/ca/<FSA>

First 3 matched characters, uppercased: M5V2T6 → /ca/M5V. No complete postcode or widget coordinates are appended. This is a prefix test, not complete-postcode validation; malformed longer queries with that prefix also trigger it.
Builder coordinate reverse lookup
Eligible coordinate edits after 700 ms debounce, or permission-granted builder location acquisition. Stale/non-numeric coordinates and both automatic label/method controls off produce no request.
BigDataCloud https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client
latitude, longitude, localityLanguage=en, e.g. 51.5/-0.12. This is the builder caller; in-widget browser location does not invoke builder reverse geocoding.
Prayer requests
Eligible date-specific prayer acquisition, subject to existing cache/currentness rules.
Aladhan https://api.aladhan.com/v1/timings/<date>
latitude, longitude, method, school; requested date in the path.
Weather requests
Eligible active current/hourly acquisition, subject to cache, simulation and currentness guards.
Open-Meteo https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast

latitude, longitude, timezone, temperature_unit (celsius/fahrenheit), wind_speed_unit=ms, forecast_days=3, and the current/hourly field selections listed below. These requests do not establish direct local precipitation observation.
Radar evidence requests
Eligible manifest, then returned latest-past frame/tile under existing weather guards.
RainViewer https://api.rainviewer.com/public/weather-maps.json and returned tile host/frame.

Returned host + frame path + /256/<z>/<x>/<y>/2/1_1.png; x/y indices derive from coordinates and disclose a location-derived area. The manifest has no coordinate query. Image alpha is not millimetres or direct local observation.
Font loading
Page stylesheet/font loading, subject to cache/network policy.
Google Fonts stylesheet fonts.googleapis.com and font resources fonts.gstatic.com.

Family/style/weight stylesheet request and returned font-resource URLs; no widget location/search fields in these source URLs. Cache-dependent declarations do not mean every font is fetched on every load.
